tenon_b1:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create a refined, high-quality game prop art direction sheet for the Chinese ancient craft fantasy VR game 考工律度. This is a FIRST DESIGN CANDIDATE, not a museum reproduction and not an engineering-validated object. One object only: a hand-held calibration master tenon, named 校准主榫. Chinese bronze-age design sophistication, beautifully purposeful craft, not a generic rectangular stick, weapon, sci-fi key, or fantasy scepter.

Composition: landscape professional industrial concept sheet on warm ivory paper. Left two-thirds a large, highly resolved three-quarter hero view, angled gently to reveal the thin side profile. Right top a true side elevation and small front elevation of the SAME design, matching all components. Right lower two close-ups: rounded grip/thumb seat and bird engraving. Sparse Chinese labels: title “主榫 · 青铜新案 B1”, and small captions “薄握位”, “温白玉校准端”, “浅浮雕鸟纹”. Small footer “概念候选 · 未定稿”. Do not include a pedestal or environment. Do not print extra explanations, decorative text, fake runes or numbers on the actual prop. Fine technical lines can indicate overall “350 mm” and square stem “106 × 106 mm”, make clear drawn as design target.

Geometry hierarchy: overall length 350 mm. Lower 105 mm is a simple straight square insertion shank, 106 x106 mm with modest softened corners, warm white jade with extremely subtle short cloudy inclusions, satin polished contact faces and one fine dark longitudinal alignment line ending in two discreet graduation cuts. The lower end must be recognizable as a square block fit, never a pointed blade or cylindrical rod. It transitions gently through the unchanged short lower shoulder, maximum width120mm. Above it is a distinctly narrower, sculptural grip: about100mm wide and 68–74mm front-to-back, tapering inward at the waist then opening into a shallow rounded crown. Visually lightweight and nuanced, continuously curved broad bevels rather than boxy geometry or crude chamfer. A shallow depressed thumb landing on the broad front face. No encircling ring, handle hole, snagging flange, or protrusion extending beyond the 120mm envelope. The jade shank must occupy about30% of the length, leaving a fully visible substantial bronze upper grip. Shape NOT copied from a vessel: this is a hand tool.

Materials/design: dark old bronze is the dominant visual material of the upper grip and fine protective side rails, edges selectively hand-burnished brown gold, small recessed green patina only, not bright green plastic or glittering gold. One restrained elongated warm-white jade insert on the thumb landing flush with bronze, asymmetric in surface design but mechanically centered. A stylized side-profile long-tailed bronze-age bird in SHALLOW low relief sweeps from the shoulder up one upper broad face; its tail creates a natural flowing S around the thumb recess. Bronze-age squared spiral leiwen appears only in thin recessed borders, not entire noisy surface coverage. Bird eye and wings geometric, elegant and integrated, not literal realistic feathers. Broad calm satin bronze fields balance fine crisp detail. The opposite side is mostly unornamented where fingers wrap, all edges rounded. Design should feel unmistakably manufactured by master craftsmen, refined weight distribution and distinct upper/lower ends. Ancient geometric calibration line continues along one side, never glowing.

Lighting: neutral soft side light and restrained rim highlight showing convex shoulder and smooth side bevel. Physically plausible bronze and jade, incredibly crisp near-hand surface study, high-end game concept rendering, natural micro-wear on contact areas. No dramatic VFX, no turquoise emission, no rubble, no hands covering the form. Maintain coherent same design in every view.

pedestal_b1:
Use case: stylized-concept. Produce a separate professional game environment PROP CONCEPT SHEET for the Chinese ancient craft fantasy VR game 考工律度. Only asset: station ③, the workshop retrieval pedestal that HOLDS a portable calibration master tenon before the player takes it away. This is NOT station④ control console. Do not depict a control panel, a giant lever, a brazier, incense burner, loot chest, or generic magic altar.

Design B1: a dignified compact square craft pedestal, footprint850x850mm, height650mm. Sophisticated Shang fangyi-inspired architecture: low stepped foot, gently recessed rectangular wall panels, narrow articulated corner ribs with softly rounded edges, calm overhanging upper rim transitioning into a recessed flat workshop tray. Visually weight-bearing and crafted, with a strong square base, slightly contracting upper body then a thin broad top cap, NOT just a uniformly thick box. Rounded touch edges, human craftsmanship and functional openings. Main visual vocabulary: dark aged bronze frame with selectively brown-gold hand-burnished high points, small green patina in recesses. Large restrained warm grey stone wall insets with subtle warm-white jade measuring strips. One broad shallow bronze taotie-like symmetrical geometric mask only on the front upper apron, framed by a narrow squared spiral leiwen band; other sides calm with low geometric bands and recessed panels. NO projecting horns, large teeth or ornamental spikes. Do not cover all surfaces with texture. Give the front a deliberate open/recessed toe space and horizontal groove separation to lighten perceived mass.

Top: a small central square calibrated receiver inset flush in the flat tray. Thin warm-white jade wear pads on four contact edges; no roof, no broad hollow vessel mouth. Two compact bronze sliding catches lie low on opposite sides of the receiver so the long grip above remains exposed. Show their guides as purposeful machined ancient dovetails rather than visible modern screws/gears. A 350mm tall master tenon may appear only in the small mechanism inset as an understated scale/context witness, with bottom105mm seated, not as a second hero. Its lower end square satin white jade106x106mm, upper grip dark bronze sculpturally waisted with rounded crown and a single shallow bird motif plus flush oval whitejade thumb insert. No cyan light, energy beam, red lock light, hologram, LED, modern UI. Placement hierarchy makes it immediately obvious where the player reaches and pulls upward. A proposal for lock/release, not falsely engineering-validated.

tenon_b2:
Use case: stylized-concept. Draw an exquisite new B2 alternative design sheet for a handheld CALIBRATION MASTER TENON from the ancient Chinese craft fantasy VR world 考工律度. One object, design exploration, never a weapon. Main title “主榫 · 青铜新案 B2”, subtitle “双夔合抱 · 玉芯准线”. Footer “概念候选 · 未定稿”. No numeric dimension arrows, no misleading engineering blueprint. A sophisticated original artifact redesign using Shang bronze geometry, not a museum-vessel replica.

Landscape warm ivory concept sheet, large three-quarter hero on left, matching smaller front and side elevations upper right, two richly resolved close-up views lower right. Clear art direction, functional silhouette, rounded shoulders and harmonious convexity. SAME design in all views.

Total design target length350mm. Bottom30percent is a plain SQUARE SECTION white jade insertion tenon, approx106mm across in both directions, with moderately softened corners and a clean flat base. Never pointed, never cylindrical. Matte polished warm-white jade, subtle short cloudy inclusions. One thin dark straight alignment score on its front and three small deliberate graduation cuts. Above it a dark bronze short rounded shoulder transitions inward toward a gracefully waisted grip, thickness about72mm, palm-friendly. Max overall width120mm. Grip narrowest around80mm wide, lightly barrel-shaped in front rather than flat rectangular paddle, with an integrated short flattened domed crown, fully round touch edges and subtle thumb saddle on the front. Its side profile is noticeably thinner than the square jade stem; the lower jade must read as a square block.

B2's distinctive identity: a narrow straight flush warm-white jade measuring spine runs up the center front of the bronze grip, as a long gently tapered strip, not a separate oval gem. It aligns exactly with the lower tenon's calibration score. Two ABSTRACT Shang-style kui-dragon bands embrace this central spine from the sides, their curled bodies forming structural flanking ribs and turning inward near the shoulders. Angular ancient squared spirals and hooked eyes, strongly simplified and low-relief. Their soft wraparound bands lead the eye through the grip's narrowing then opening form. The pattern and silhouette work together: refined, restrained, authoritative. Rounded bands, no jutting horns, no literal animal sculpture, no giant beast mask or decorative ears. Mainly quiet dark bronze fields around the narrow carved elements; leave back and finger contact areas smooth. Small geometric notches at upper rim, no continuous ornate border covering everything.

Material: deep brown-black antique bronze, subdued bronze gold exposed edges, minute mottled green patina in recessed incisions. Warm white jade insert and shank, fine tactile surface. Soft studio side light shows bevel roundness, actual volume and material distinction. Beautiful craft, light and elegant in hand, not a chunky solid brick. No glowing lines, modern LEDs, circuit boards, blades, firearm grips, fabric, jewelry chains, pedestal, environment, hands, or hovering parts.

Text only: title and subtitle as above; tiny labels “正视”, “侧视”, “圆肩与薄握位”, “玉芯准线”; footer as above. No additional prose. The sheet should look like premium art-director-ready game prop design, high aesthetic quality, distinct design intelligence, believable construction, natural nonuniform micro-wear.
